people.name: Eliashib
people.line: High priest during Nehemiah's time, involved in rebuilding Jerusalem's wall

people.name: Hakkoz
people.line: A priest who helped repair the wall of Jerusalem.

people.name: Meremoth
people.line: A priest who returned from the Babylonian exile.

people.name: Uriah
people.line: Postexilic priest involved in rebuilding the wall

translations.web: After him, Meremoth the son of Uriah the son of Hakkoz repaired another portion, from the door of the house of Eliashib even to the end of the house of Eliashib.
translations.bsb: Next to him, Meremoth son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz, repaired another section, from the doorway of the house of Eliashib to the end of the house.
translations.kjv: After him repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah the son of Koz another piece, from the door of the house of Eliashib even to the end of the house of Eliashib.
translations.asv: After him repaired Meremoth the son of Uriah the son of Hakkoz another portion, from the door of the house of Eliashib even to the end of the house of Eliashib.
